meta.title: ExperimentLens — Observability & explainability for agents, LLMs and ML experiments
meta.description: A visual analytics dashboard for agentic and ML systems. Trace agents and LLM apps with Langfuse, score them with judges and checks, compare sessions — then drill into the same runs, metrics and explainability you already track.

agenticHero.titlePost: your agents, LLM apps and ML experiments.
agenticHero.subtitle:
It captures full traces, LLM-as-judge verdicts and deterministic checks for every run — so you can see exactly how your agents retrieve, reason and answer.

ExperimentLens turns agent experiments into actionable insights. Teams can compare different agent configurations, understand what drives performance, and quickly identify where an agent succeeds or fails — making it easier to build, evaluate and improve reliable agentic AI.
agenticHero.imageCaption: ExperimentLens demo: pick the best configuration and prove it.

agenticValueProps.title: See how your agents actually behave.
agenticValueProps.subtitle: From the first span to the final verdict — every run, fully traced and scored.

items.title: End-to-end tracing
items.body: Records every observation — retrievers, LLM calls and judges — with latency, tokens and cost captured per step of the trace.

items.title: Judges & verdicts
items.body: LLM-as-judge scores sit next to deterministic checks like citation validity and exact match — in a single pass/fail verdict grid.

items.title: Compare sessions
items.body: Compare runs up side by side: judge pass-rates, token usage, cumulative latency races and a verdict diff that flags every regression and fix between configurations.

items.title: Agent performance
items.body: Per-agent latency, call frequency and quality breakdowns reveal which step is slowing you down or reducing overall quality.

agenticShowcase.title: Traces, verdicts and dashboards — in one lens.
agenticShowcase.subtitle: Explore the same run you launch as an experiment, all the way down to a single LLM call.

cards.title: Overview dashboard
cards.sub: Stats, trends & a one-click LLM trace scan

cards.title: Question & answer
cards.sub: Full answer, evaluation & rationale in one view

cards.title: Human annotations
cards.sub: Rate and comment on every trace

hero.subtitle:
ExperimentLens is a lightweight yet powerful visual dashboard for the interactive exploration, monitoring, and explainability of complex AI pipelines.
It empowers researchers, data scientists, and engineers to make sense of experimental results across multiple runs and interconnected tasks.
hero.imageAlt: ExperimentLens overview dashboard with parallel coordinates plot across 108 runs
hero.imageCaption: ExperimentLens dashboard: analyzing configuration effects on experiment performance.

valueProps.title: A single lens over your entire ML experimentation loop.
valueProps.subtitle: From orchestration to explanation — without leaving the browser.

items.title: Tracker- & engine-agnostic
items.body: An adapter-based interface supports MLflow today, with Kubeflow serving as the execution engine. Airflow and other backends are on the roadmap.

items.title: Visual analytics, not just tables
items.body: Parallel coordinates, comparative metric views, grouping, filters and color encodings — designed to make hundreds of runs legible at a glance.

items.title: Built-in explainability
items.body: Feature importance, Partial Dependence (PDP), Accumulated Local Effects (ALE) and counterfactual views wired directly to your runs.

featuresPreview.title: Built for the whole experiment lifecycle.
featuresPreview.subtitle: From first run to final explanation — everything in one UI.

integrations.title: Works with the stack you already run.
integrations.subtitle: ExperimentLens consumes runs from your tracker, traces from your agent stack, and orchestrates them through your engine.

cards.name: Langfuse
cards.body: Langfuse captures traces from your agents and LLM applications. ExperimentLens reads those traces directly, so every span, generation, judge and check maps back to the run that produced it.

cards.name: MLflow
cards.body: Logs runs, parameters, metrics and artifacts. ExperimentLens reads MLflow experiments directly so every visualization, comparison and explanation maps back to a real run.

cards.name: Kubeflow
cards.body: Kubeflow runs the underlying pipelines on Kubernetes. ExperimentLens surfaces Kubeflow pipeline executions as first-class workflows you can inspect, compare and explain.

integrations.footnote: Adapter-based design — additional trackers and execution engines, such as Airflow, can be integrated without changing the UI.

howItWorks.title: From pipeline to insight in three steps.

steps.title: Orchestrate
steps.body: Define your experiment as a pipeline in your execution engine. ExperimentLens surfaces it as a first-class workflow.

steps.title: Track
steps.body: Each run logs parameters, metrics and artifacts to the tracker, which ExperimentLens automatically surfaces in the dashboard.

steps.title: Explore & explain
steps.body: Compare runs visually, drill into artifacts and apply explainability methods without leaving the UI.
